title: Special Topics in Public Policy; Working Towards Racial Equity and Diversity Engagement in the Nonprofit Sector
description: This course is designed to introduce the importance and value of racial equity and diversity engagement for solution-based cause work - particularly those issues impacting underrepresented and at-risk communities. This course will explore the nuances of engagement with audiences that arediverse based on racial ethnicity, gender and sexual orientation. Stud ents will learn about the nuanced history of the nonprofit sector and the intersections of social policy and identities that have led to the current inequities and systemic issues that plague the sector. Using experiential learning, students will learn to craft nonprofit communications, develop fundraising and governance strategies that caterto diverse audiences, particularly for the purposes of leadingsocial change, recruiting and retaining diverse donors, volunteers, board members. At the conclusion of the semester student teams will share their hands-on experience working alongside a local nonprofit organization on racial equity and diversity engagement challenges
